visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up on the torso of a man wearing a black sweatshirt with a red and blue graphic. He holds a brown patterned wallet and begins counting out Taiwanese currency bills. A woman's hand reaches into the frame to take the bills as they are offered. The background is a paved outdoor parking area next to a white car. (2) The camera zooms in slightly as the man hands over more 100 NTD red bills. The visual style briefly switches to a black and white filter for comedic dramatic effect. The woman's hands fumbled with the cash near the white car's rear bumper. (3) The woman accidentally drops a bill onto the asphalt ground near the car tire. The man bends down, his back to the camera, to pick it up. The camera follows this movement downward. The lighting is bright natural daylight with sharp shadows on the ground. (4) Transition to a medium close-up of the woman facing the camera. She wears a brown blazer over a black turtleneck and has distinct earrings. She holds the three red bills near her face and looks directly into the lens with a sarcastic smile and laughter. The background shows a modern grey building wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female voice speaks with high pitch and high arousal, sounding extremely excited. Upbeat pop music with a strong synthesizer beat and electronic drums plays at a moderate volume. Ambient outdoor noise floor is low with slight wind resonance. (2) A distinct, high-pitched pig squeal effect is made by the female speaker, followed by sharp vocal transients and excited laughter. BGM continues with high energy and a driving rhythm. (3) Sudden shift in BGM to a slow, minor-key piano melody with high reverb and emotional weight. Female voice takes on a mock-crying tone, exaggeratedly expressing disappointment or sadness. (4) A percussive thud sound occurs as money hits the ground. Upbeat BGM resumes immediately. A male voice enters with a calm, moderate pitch, speaking with authority and gentle humor, telling her to save. (5) Final segment features the female voice speaking with high clarity and a humorous, sarcastic tone at a moderate rate. The upbeat BGM remains consistent until the track fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic short video intended for social media entertainment. It depicts a wife asking her husband for an allowance for a trip to Taipei, only to react with dramatic sarcasm and mock disappointment when he only gives her 300 NTD.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes classic social media editing tropes, including dramatic music shifts and black-and-white filters, to emphasize comedic beats.
